prompt:
Editorial architecture photograph of a vast exhibition hall at night, dark charcoal concrete floor and deep shadowed walls. The only light comes from a few hard theatrical spotlights high above, shining down through four huge flat sheets of transparent coloured glass hanging from fine steel cables in a staggered row that steps toward the camera <glass_sheets>: a small sunflower yellow sheet farthest away, then an emerald green sheet twice its size, then a magenta sheet twice that size, then an enormous cobalt blue sheet nearest the camera at the right edge. The beams project sharp-edged, vivid rectangles of yellow, green, magenta and cobalt light onto the dark floor <light_shapes>, overlapping into mixed colours; everything else falls into near-black. Clean air: no haze, no fog, no volumetric beams, no glow, no neon tubes, no lens flare. The left third of the frame is dark and calm with only faint colour on the floor <quiet_zone>. No people, no furniture, no text, no signage, no logos, no screens or devices. Medium format camera, 35 mm equivalent lens at eye level, sharp focus, fine grain, rich deep blacks and saturated colour.
